# rendehR

rendehR turns raw ICU electronic health records from MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV
and eICU-CRD into analysis-ready, harmonized tables. It is
**cohort-first**: you define the study cohort before any large event
table is imported, so only the rows your study needs are streamed to
Parquet, loaded into PostgreSQL and processed. Every derived concept is
linked to its source, extraction layer and SQL in a provenance registry.

The output is the same for every source: one row per admission or ICU
stay (**flat**), long-format measurements (**time series**) and
intervals such as ventilation or vasopressor exposure (**durations**),
merged across sources into one schema.

![The rendehR pipeline: download raw data, define and import the cohort,
extract concepts, harmonize and merge the sources,
analyse.](reference/figures/pipeline.svg)

## Installation

Install from GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ATE-DRIVEN-lab/rendehR")
```

The articles’ plots and the cohort explorer use suggested packages
(ggplot2, shiny, plotly, DT and others). To install those as well:

``` r
pak::pak("ATE-DRIVEN-lab/rendehR", dependencies = TRUE)
```

The articles are on the
[website](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/). To also keep them
locally as vignettes, build them while installing:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ATE-DRIVEN-lab/rendehR", dependencies = TRUE,
                        build_vignettes = TRUE, force = TRUE)
```

On Linux the dependencies are compiled from source, which can take most
of an hour; [Posit Package Manager](https://packagemanager.posit.co)
serves binaries if you set it as your CRAN repository.

rendehR needs a PostgreSQL server for the full pipeline; DuckDB
(installed with the package) covers import, cohort tables and concept
extraction on its own. The interactive explorer uses the suggested
packages shiny, bslib, bsicons, plotly, DT, shinyWidgets,
shinycssloaders and survival.

## Example

Build a Sepsis-3 cohort from the open MIMIC-IV demo, merge it and read
first-day summaries:

``` r
library(rendehR)

# Writes config/ehr_config.json and config/config_pass.json in the working
# directory. Add your PostgreSQL credentials to config_pass.json.
ehr_init_project(src_name = "mimic_iv_demo")
download_source("mimic_iv_demo")

# Import only the cohort's rows, then run every stage up to the
# harmonized tables.
run_one_source(
  "mimic_iv_demo",
  db_name = "sepsis_demo",
  cohort_selection = cohort_selection_options(cohort = "sepsis3")
)

# Merge one or more sources into an analysis schema ("rendehr").
merge_sources("mimic_iv_demo", db_name = "sepsis_demo")

ehr_connect("sepsis_demo")
baseline <- load_merged_flat(schema = "rendehr")
day_one  <- load_merged_ts_wide(
  schema  = "rendehr",
  spec    = list(heart_rate = c("min", "max"), lactate = "max", spo2 = "min"),
  bin_min = 24 * 60,
  window  = c(0, 0)
)
```

[`list_example_cohorts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/list_example_cohorts.md)
shows the bundled cohorts (spinal cord injury and Sepsis-3). Your own
cohort can be an ICD list (`icd_filter_path`), a list of patient or
admission IDs (`direct_ids_path`), SQL (`cohort_sql`) or an R function
(`cohort_fn`).

## How it works

[`run_one_source()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_one_source.md)
runs these stages in order; each one can also be called, checked and
rerun on its own:

| Stage              | Function                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | What it does                                                                  |
|:-------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Cohort import      | [`import_cohort_general()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/import_cohort_general.md)                                                                                                                         | Selects the cohort and streams its rows from `.csv.gz` to Parquet with DuckDB |
| Database load      | [`run_db()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_db.md)                                                                                                                                                       | Loads the Parquet artifact into PostgreSQL (or a DuckDB file)                 |
| eICU preprocessing | [`run_raw_mods()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_raw_mods.md)                                                                                                                                           | Builds the eICU `*_mod` tables that several concepts read                     |
| Visit windows      | [`build_window_tables()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_window_tables.md)                                                                                                                             | Admission and ICU timelines                                                   |
| Cohort table       | [`build_cohort_info_general()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort_info_general.md), [`build_cohort_annotations()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort_annotations.md) | One row per hospitalization, with cohort membership                           |
| Comorbidities      | [`run_comorbidities()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_comorbidities.md)                                                                                                                                 | Charlson and Elixhauser indices                                               |
| Injury severity    | [`run_iss()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_iss.md)                                                                                                                                                     | ISS, NISS and AIS from injury diagnoses                                       |
| Concepts           | [`run_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_concepts.md), [`run_external_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_external_concepts.md)                                 | Flat, time-series and duration concepts; adapted MIT-LCP SQL                  |
| Harmonization      | [`run_harmonized_tables()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_harmonized_tables.md)                                                                                                                         | Source-level flat, time-series and duration tables                            |

[`merge_sources()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/merge_sources.md)
then combines sources at the admission or ICU-stay level. Times are
minutes since hospital admission, with minutes since ICU admission kept
where a stay exists. With `engine = "duckdb"` the cohort is built in a
local DuckDB file without PostgreSQL; the PostgreSQL-only stages are
skipped.
[`run_one_source_test()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_one_source_test.md)
resumes a partial run, and
[`verify_download()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_download.md),
[`verify_db_load()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_db_load.md),
[`verify_cohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_cohort.md),
[`verify_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_concepts.md)
and
[`verify_harmonized()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_harmonized.md)
check each stage’s output.

## Data sources

| Source         | Release | ICU stays | Patients | Access                 |
|:---------------|:--------|----------:|---------:|:-----------------------|
| MIMIC-III      | 1.4     |    61,532 |   46,476 | PhysioNet credentialed |
| MIMIC-IV       | 3.1     |    94,458 |   65,366 | PhysioNet credentialed |
| eICU-CRD       | 2.0     |   200,859 |  139,367 | PhysioNet credentialed |
| MIMIC-III demo | 1.4     |       136 |      100 | Open                   |
| MIMIC-IV demo  | 2.2     |       140 |      100 | Open                   |
| eICU-CRD demo  | 2.0.1   |     2,520 |    1,841 | Open                   |

MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV come from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical
Center; eICU-CRD from 208 US hospitals. New sources are added through a
source definition, identifier mappings and concept recipes
([`vignette("adding-a-new-source", package = "rendehR")`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/articles/adding-a-new-source.md)).

## Clinical concepts

| Layer          | Examples                                                                                                                           |
|:---------------|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Flat           | Demographics, admission and discharge, length of stay, mortality                                                                   |
| Time series    | Vital signs, blood gases, chemistry and haematology (130 concepts)                                                                 |
| Durations      | Ventilation, vasopressors, antibiotics and other medication exposures                                                              |
| Repository SQL | SOFA, SAPS-II, LODS and other scores adapted from MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code and eICU-Code                                                 |
| Your own       | Project SQL registered with [`register_concept_sql()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/register_concept_sql.md) |

Each concept carries its origin, citation and SQL in the provenance
registry.

## Cohort explorer

``` r
run_explorer("rendehr", db_name = "sepsis_demo")   # opens http://127.0.0.1:<port>
```

A Shiny app over the merged schema: cohort overview, filters and a
characteristics table with standardized mean differences, outcomes with
Wilson 95% confidence intervals, Kaplan-Meier survival, cross-tabs, a
per-patient timeline, the concept inventory with a concept builder, and
project setup that runs the pipeline as background jobs. Studies can add
their own pages; the spinal cord injury pages
([`explorer_sci_data()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/explorer_sci_data.md))
are the reference example. The app shows individual-level data and
listens on `127.0.0.1` only; do not deploy it publicly.

## Validation

Each release is checked by an independent validation harness on the demo
and full datasets: raw-data oracles, concept fidelity, determinism
across rebuilds, robustness, the explorer and concordance with
[ricu](https://github.com/eth-mds/ricu). The harness is kept in the
development repository; its method and results are summarised in the
[validation
article](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/articles/validation.html).

`devtools::test()` runs the offline test suite. Tests that need a
database are skipped unless these variables point at **disposable**
resources (several tests drop and rebuild schemas):

| Variable                                                                         | Enables                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `EHR_TEST_DB`, `EHR_CREDS_PATH`                                                  | access, merge and membership tests on a built demo database                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `EHR_TEST_PG_DB`                                                                 | PostgreSQL fixture tests (an empty scratch database)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `EHR_TEST_JOIN_DB`                                                               | PostgreSQL join regression tests                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `EHR_TEST_E2E_DB`, `EHR_TEST_E2E_RAW_ROOT`                                       | end-to-end build of the demo sources on both engines; the database name must contain `scratch` or `e2e`, and the raw root must hold `mimic_iv_demo/` and `eicu_demo/` as [`download_source()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/download_source.md) writes them |
| `EHR_TEST_EXPLORER_DB`, `EHR_TEST_EXPLORER_SCHEMA`, `EHR_TEST_EXPLORER_RAW_ROOT` | the cohort explorer on a merged schema (read only)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `RENDEHR_EXPLORER_SCI_DIR` and related `RENDEHR_EXPLORER_SCI_*`                  | the spinal cord injury explorer pages                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `EHR_TEST_MCP_CONFIG`, `EHR_TEST_MCP_SOURCE`                                     | the bundled MCP server’s database tools (read only)                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

PostgreSQL credentials come from `PGHOST`, `PGUSER` and `PGPASSWORD`.

## AI assistant integration

A local MCP server and three skills (`rendehr-user`,
`rendehr-add-concept`, `rendehr-add-source`) are bundled under
`inst/mcp`; see its
[README](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/inst/mcp/README.md).
Installing the package does not start the server or activate the skills.

# Package index

## Project setup and configuration

Create, load and inspect the project configuration and credentials that
every other function reads from.

- [`ehr_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_config.md)
  : Return the active project configuration
- [`ehr_use_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_use_config.md)
  : Use a project configuration for this R session
- [`ehr_load_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_load_config.md)
  : Load project configuration from a JSON file
- [`ehr_write_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_write_config.md)
  : Write a project configuration JSON file
- [`ehr_check_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_check_config.md)
  : Check a project configuration
- [`ehr_create_config_template()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_create_config_template.md)
  : Create a starter project configuration file
- [`ehr_config_path()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_config_path.md)
  : Path to a bundled package config file
- [`ehr_config_root()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_config_root.md)
  : Root of the external user config directory
- [`ehr_paths()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_paths.md)
  : Build the standard project path list for a source
- [`ehr_init_project()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_init_project.md)
  : Create project directories for a source
- [`ehr_create_credentials_template()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_create_credentials_template.md)
  : Create a starter credentials file
- [`load_credentials()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_credentials.md)
  : Load Postgres and PhysioNet credentials
- [`set_physionet_env()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/set_physionet_env.md)
  : Set credentials for a protected PhysioNet operation
- [`load_src_cfg()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_src_cfg.md)
  : Load a single source config block from a data-sources JSON file
- [`get_dataset_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/get_dataset_config.md)
  : Get source dataset configuration
- [`get_id_cols()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/get_id_cols.md)
  : Get identifier columns for a source table
- [`src_family()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/src_family.md)
  : Canonical source family name
- [`src_schema_names()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/src_schema_names.md)
  : Build the standard Postgres schema name list for a source

  : Write a generated setup script to disk

- [`ehr_add_source_assistant()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_add_source_assistant.md)
  : Interactive assistant for adding a new data source

- [`ehr_suggest_next()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_suggest_next.md)
  : Suggest the next rendehR pipeline command

  :

  Print an `rendehR` setup assistant plan

- [`print(`*`<ehr_add_source_plan>`*`)`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/print.ehr_add_source_plan.md)

  Print an `rendehR` add-source assistant plan

- [`print(`*`<ehr_suggestion>`*`)`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/print.ehr_suggestion.md)
  : Print a suggested next pipeline step

## Download raw data

Fetch raw source tables from PhysioNet as Parquet.

- [`download_source()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/download_source.md)
  : Download raw EHR source tables
- [`download_sources()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/download_sources.md)
  : Download raw EHR source tables for multiple sources

## Cohort definition and materialization

Define the study cohort first, then stream only cohort-relevant rows
into Parquet and load them into a database backend.

- [`build_cohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort.md)
  : High-level pipeline API - cfg-accepting wrappers
- [`cohort_key()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/cohort_key.md)
  : Return the primary cohort key column for a source
- [`subset_parquet_by_key()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/subset_parquet_by_key.md)
  : Safely subset one parquet file to rows matching key values
- [`import_cohort_general()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/import_cohort_general.md)
  : Materialize the current cohort as canonical Parquet
- [`cache_raw_parquet_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/cache_raw_parquet_duckdb.md)
  : Materialize a source's raw CSVs as a parquet cache for fast cohort
  selection
- [`cohort_selection_options()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/cohort_selection_options.md)
  : Specify cohort selection options
- [`build_sepsis_cohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_sepsis_cohort.md)
  : Build a Sepsis-3 cohort ID list for a source, optionally importing
  it
- [`run_sepsis3_example()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_sepsis3_example.md)
  : Run the Sepsis-3 reference pipeline and verify output
- [`select_cohort_ids()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/select_cohort_ids.md)
  : Select and normalize cohort identifiers
- [`print(`*`<ehr_selection_plan>`*`)`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/print.ehr_selection_plan.md)
  : Print a cohort selection plan
- [`run_cohort_info()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_cohort_info.md)
  : Build and optionally publish cohort information
- [`scid_classify()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/scid_classify.md)
  : SCI-specific classify_fn for use with run_cohort_info()
- [`build_cohort_info()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort_info.md)
  : Build generic cohort information
- [`build_cohort_info_general()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort_info_general.md)
  : Build cohort_info from generalized cohort_index metadata
- [`build_cohort_info_general_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort_info_general_duckdb.md)
  : Build generalized cohort_info in a DuckDB database
- [`build_cohort_annotations()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort_annotations.md)
  : Build cohort annotation tables (ICD lookup, injury cause, derived
  flags)
- [`build_cohort_annotations_general()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_cohort_annotations_general.md)
  : Build generalized cohort annotation tables
- [`load_cohort_parquet_to_postgres()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_cohort_parquet_to_postgres.md)
  : Load all parquet files from a cohort directory into Postgres
- [`load_cohort_parquet_to_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_cohort_parquet_to_duckdb.md)
  : Load all parquet files from a cohort directory into DuckDB
- [`materialize_cohort_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/materialize_cohort_duckdb.md)
  : Materialize the current cohort as a persistent DuckDB database
- [`list_example_cohorts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/list_example_cohorts.md)
  : List the example cohorts bundled with the package

## Pipeline stages

End-to-end and per-stage runners for one or many sources.

- [`run_one_source()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_one_source.md)
  : Run an EHR processing pipeline for one source
- [`pipeline_options`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/pipeline_options.md)
  : Configure the source pipeline
- [`window_options()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/window_options.md)
  : Specify observation-window options
- [`loading_options()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/loading_options.md)
  : Specify import and database-loading options
- [`enrichment_options()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/enrichment_options.md)
  : Specify cohort-enrichment options
- [`concept_options()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/concept_options.md)
  : Specify concept-extraction options
- [`harmonization_options()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/harmonization_options.md)
  : Specify harmonized-output options
- [`execution_options()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/execution_options.md)
  : Specify pipeline execution options
- [`pipeline_compatibility`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/pipeline_compatibility.md)
  : Compatibility arguments for the source pipeline
- [`run_one_source_test()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_one_source_test.md)
  : Run a source pipeline with validation-aware resume checks
- [`run_sources()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_sources.md)
  : Run all pipeline stages for multiple sources
- [`run_scid_example()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_scid_example.md)
  : Run the SCI reference pipeline and verify output
- [`run_db()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_db.md)
  : Load cohort parquet into Postgres
- [`run_db_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_db_duckdb.md)
  : Create a cohort database in DuckDB
- [`run_raw_mods()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_raw_mods.md)
  : Build modified (\_mod) versions of raw tables for a source
- [`run_raw_mods_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_raw_mods_duckdb.md)
  : Build modified (\_mod) raw tables in a DuckDB cohort database
- [`run_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_concepts.md)
  : Extract concepts for one source
- [`build_window_tables()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_window_tables.md)
  : Build admission, ICU, and visit window tables for any source
- [`build_icu_windows()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_icu_windows.md)
  : Build ICU windows for a source
- [`build_visit_windows()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_visit_windows.md)
  : Build visit windows for a source

## Clinical concepts

Generate, register, clean and inspect atomic and handcrafted clinical
concepts, with concept-level provenance.

- [`extract_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/extract_concepts.md)
  : Extract atomic and handcrafted concepts for the configured source
- [`run_atomic_concepts_unified()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_atomic_concepts_unified.md)
  : Execute atomic concept SQL for all concepts matching a source and
  type
- [`concept_unit_conversion_func()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/concept_unit_conversion_func.md)
  : Build SQL for a concept's unit conversion
- [`run_external_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_external_concepts.md)
  : Run MIMIC-code / eICU-code handcrafted SQL concepts.
- [`run_flat_sql_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_flat_sql_concepts.md)
  : Execute flat SQL concept files for one source
- [`register_concept_sql()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/register_concept_sql.md)
  : Extension utilities: bring-your-own SQL + project workspace helpers.
- [`register_concept_provenance()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/register_concept_provenance.md)
  : Register provenance metadata for one or more concepts
- [`list_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/list_concepts.md)
  : List all concept tables available for a source
- [`search_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/search_concepts.md)
  : Search for concept names matching a pattern
- [`concept_summary()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/concept_summary.md)
  : Summary statistics for one concept
- [`clean_by_range()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/clean_by_range.md)
  : Clean concept values using config-defined plausibility ranges
- [`clean_by_outlier()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/clean_by_outlier.md)
  : Clean concept values using statistical outlier rules

## Derived clinical measures

Comorbidity indices, injury severity scores and ICU timelines.

- [`run_comorbidities()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_comorbidities.md)
  : Compute hospital-level Charlson and Elixhauser comorbidities
- [`run_iss()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_iss.md)
  : Compute hospital-level injury severity measures
- [`make_icu_timeline()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/make_icu_timeline.md)
  : Build an ICU-assigned timeline from a native-grain harmonized table
- [`build_eicu_diagnosis_icd_parquet()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_eicu_diagnosis_icd_parquet.md)
  : Build a normalized eICU diagnosis ICD parquet table from CSV files

## Harmonization and merging

Build flat, time-series and duration outputs and merge them across
sources.

- [`harmonize_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/harmonize_concepts.md)
  : Build harmonized ts_tab and flat_tab output tables
- [`run_harmonized_tables()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_harmonized_tables.md)
  : Build harmonized ts_tab and flat_tab output tables for one source
- [`merge_sources()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/merge_sources.md)
  : Merge harmonized source tables across sources into one schema.

## Accessing harmonized data

Connect to the database and pull tables, concepts and patients into
tibbles.

- [`ehr_connect()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_connect.md)
  : Store database credentials for use by all fetch\_\* functions

- [`ehr_disconnect()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ehr_disconnect.md)
  : Clear stored credentials

- [`list_sources()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/list_sources.md)
  : List all rendehR sources present in the database

- [`list_tables()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/list_tables.md)
  : List all tables in a source schema

- [`peek_table()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/peek_table.md)
  : Preview the first N rows of any table

- [`fetch_table()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/fetch_table.md)
  : Fetch a table from any source schema into a tibble

- [`fetch_concept()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/fetch_concept.md)
  : Fetch one atomic concept table into a tibble

- [`fetch_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/fetch_concepts.md)
  : Fetch multiple concept tables and stack them into long format

- [`fetch_concepts_wide()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/fetch_concepts_wide.md)
  : Pivot the harmonized time series into wide format (one column per
  concept)

- [`get_patient_flat()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/get_patient_flat.md)
  : Fetch the flat (baseline) row for one patient

- [`get_patient_ts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/get_patient_ts.md)
  : Fetch all time-series data for one patient

- [`load_cohort_info()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_cohort_info.md)
  : Fetch the cohort_info table for a source

- [`load_admission_windows()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_admission_windows.md)
  : Fetch the admission_windows table for a source

- [`load_icu_windows()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_icu_windows.md)
  : Fetch the icu_windows table for a source

- [`load_visit_windows()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_visit_windows.md)
  : Fetch the visit_windows table for a source

- [`load_merged_cohort_info()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_merged_cohort_info.md)
  : Load the merged cohort_info table from any merged schema

- [`load_merged_flat()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_merged_flat.md)
  : Load the merged flat table from any merged schema

- [`load_merged_dur()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_merged_dur.md)
  : Load the merged duration table from any merged schema

- [`load_merged_dur_wide()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_merged_dur_wide.md)
  : Pivot the merged duration table into a time-binned wide grid

- [`load_merged_ts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_merged_ts.md)
  : Load the merged timeseries table from any merged schema

- [`load_merged_ts_wide()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/load_merged_ts_wide.md)
  : Pivot the merged time series into wide format (one column per
  concept)

- [`cohort_summary()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/cohort_summary.md)
  : High-level summary of a source cohort

- [`browse_source()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/browse_source.md)
  [`open_source()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/browse_source.md)
  : Browse one source schema with interactive \$ access

- [`browse_ehr_db_flex()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/browse_ehr_db_flex.md)
  : Browse all EHR database tables with flexible access

- [`disconnect_ehr_db()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/disconnect_ehr_db.md)
  :

  Disconnect a database browser returned by
  [`browse_ehr_db_flex()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/browse_ehr_db_flex.md)

- [`print(`*`<ehr_source>`*`)`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/print.ehr_source.md)
  : Print a lazy source browser

- [`print(`*`<ehr_db_flex_browser>`*`)`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/print.ehr_db_flex_browser.md)
  : Print a flexible database browser

## Patient subgroups and time windows

Filter an existing cohort into subgroups and time windows, then
materialize them.

- [`build_subcohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/build_subcohort.md)
  : Build a patient subgroup ID list by filtering cohort_info
- [`set_active_cohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/set_active_cohort.md)
  : Activate a patient subgroup filter for a source
- [`active_cohort_info()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/active_cohort_info.md)
  : Show currently active patient subgroup filters
- [`clear_active_cohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/clear_active_cohort.md)
  : Clear the active patient subgroup filter
- [`set_time_window()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/set_time_window.md)
  : Set the time window reference for a source
- [`active_time_window_info()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/active_time_window_info.md)
  : Show currently active time window filters
- [`clear_time_window()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/clear_time_window.md)
  : Clear the time window filter
- [`materialize_subcohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/materialize_subcohort.md)
  : Materialize a patient subgroup as new Postgres schemas
- [`drop_subcohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/drop_subcohort.md)
  : Drop all schemas for a materialized subgroup

## Cohort explorer

Interactive Shiny explorer of a merged schema: cohort overview and
filters, Table 1, outcomes and survival, one patient’s time series read
live, concepts and data quality. Optional study pages (spinal cord
injury as the reference example).

- [`run_explorer()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_explorer.md)
  : Run the cohort explorer
- [`explorer_app()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/explorer_app.md)
  : Build the cohort explorer Shiny app
- [`explorer_data()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/explorer_data.md)
  : Build the data bundle for the cohort explorer
- [`explorer_patient_ts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/explorer_patient_ts.md)
  [`explorer_patient_dur()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/explorer_patient_ts.md)
  : Read one patient's harmonized time series for the explorer
- [`explorer_sci_data()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/explorer_sci_data.md)
  [`explorer_add_sci()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/explorer_sci_data.md)
  : Load the optional SCI pages of the cohort explorer

## Writing and exporting

Push data back into a schema or export it to Parquet / gzip CSV.

- [`write_table()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/write_table.md)
  : Write a data frame to a source schema
- [`write_csv_to_schema()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/write_csv_to_schema.md)
  : Write a CSV file directly to a source schema
- [`write_lookup_table()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/write_lookup_table.md)
  : Write a data frame as a lookup table in Postgres
- [`export_query()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/export_query.md)
  : Export any SQL query to parquet or csv.gz
- [`export_table_parquet()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/export_table_parquet.md)
  : Export a table or query result to a Parquet dataset (chunked, low
  RAM)
- [`export_table_csv_gz()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/export_table_csv_gz.md)
  : Export a table or query result to a gzip-compressed CSV (chunked,
  low RAM)

## Database utilities

Low-level PostgreSQL and DuckDB helpers used throughout the pipeline.

- [`connect_postgres()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/connect_postgres.md)
  : Open a connection to a Postgres database
- [`connect_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/connect_duckdb.md)
  : Open a connection to a DuckDB cohort database
- [`ensure_database_exists()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/ensure_database_exists.md)
  : Create the target database if it does not exist
- [`create_schemas()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/create_schemas.md)
  : Create all schemas in a schema_names list if they don't exist
- [`create_index()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/create_index.md)
  : Create a Postgres index if it doesn't already exist
- [`get_table_from_db()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/get_table_from_db.md)
  : Fetch a table (or the first n rows) from Postgres into a tibble
- [`run_sql_file()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_sql_file.md)
  : Execute a single .sql file against an open connection
- [`run_sql_dir()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/run_sql_dir.md)
  : Execute all .sql files in a directory, sorted alphabetically
- [`adapt_sql_for_duckdb()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/adapt_sql_for_duckdb.md)
  : Adapt conservative PostgreSQL SQL syntax to DuckDB
- [`browse_psql()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/browse_psql.md)
  : Browse databases on a Postgres server
- [`suggest_match()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/suggest_match.md)
  : Suggest close matches for a query string against a set of choices

## Dropping objects

Safely remove tables, schemas and databases.

- [`drop_table()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/drop_table.md)
  : Safely drop a single table from a source schema
- [`drop_relation()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/drop_relation.md)
  : Drop a single relation (table, view, or materialized view) by name
- [`drop_schema()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/drop_schema.md)
  : Safely drop an entire schema for a source
- [`drop_source_schemas()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/drop_source_schemas.md)
  : Safely drop all schemas for a source
- [`drop_merged_schema()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/drop_merged_schema.md)
  : Safely drop a merged schema
- [`drop_database()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/drop_database.md)
  : Drop a Postgres database entirely

## Extending rendehR

Register new source families and set up project-specific workspaces.

- [`register_source()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/register_source.md)
  : Register a data source family
- [`list_registered_sources()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/list_registered_sources.md)
  : List registered source families
- [`validate_source_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/validate_source_config.md)
  : Validate a source configuration
- [`add_source_wizard()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/add_source_wizard.md)
  : Scaffold a new data source
- [`init_project_schema()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/init_project_schema.md)
  : Create a dedicated project schema in the connected database
- [`clone_source_to_db()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/clone_source_to_db.md)
  : Copy a source's schemas into a different Postgres database

## Validation

Stage-by-stage checks that each pipeline step produced what it should
have.

- [`verify_download()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_download.md)
  : Verify a source's cohort Parquet artifact
- [`verify_cohort()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_cohort.md)
  : Verify cohort anchor table was built correctly
- [`verify_db_load()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_db_load.md)
  : Verify raw tables were loaded into Postgres
- [`verify_concepts()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_concepts.md)
  : Verify atomic concept tables were created
- [`verify_handcrafted()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_handcrafted.md)
  : Verify handcrafted concept tables (SOFA, vitalsign, scores, etc.)
- [`verify_harmonized()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/verify_harmonized.md)
  : Verify harmonized ts_tab, flat_tab, and dur_tab outputs
- [`validate_concepts_against_ricu()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/validate_concepts_against_ricu.md)
  : Compare concept config item IDs against ricu's concept dictionary
- [`validate_concept_config()`](https://ate-driven-lab.github.io/rendehR/reference/validate_concept_config.md)
  : Check a concept configuration for invalid rows
